values.headline: Free while UniteTrip is in early access
values.subheadline: Every feature, for every trip and every traveler. The only cost is your payment processor's own fee, and UniteTrip adds nothing to it.

values.heading: What payments cost
values.body:
Travelers pay online through your organization's own Stripe or PayPal account. The processor charges its standard fee on each payment, and that fee is the only cost of taking money online.

You decide whether travelers pay the fee on top of the price or your organization absorbs it. UniteTrip takes no share of any payment.

children.title: Do we need a credit card to start?

values.body: No. There is nothing to pay, so there is nothing to enter.

children.title: Is there a limit on trips or travelers?

values.body: No. Run as many trips, with as many travelers, as your organization needs.
Pricing for later has not been set. If UniteTrip ever charges for anything, every organization will hear about it well ahead of time.

children.title: Can we use our own domain?

values.body: Yes. Your site starts at your-name.unitetrip.com, and a domain you already own can point to it instead. We set that up with you.

values.heading: Start your first trip
values.text: Create an account and we will set up your organization's site with you.

values.headline: Registration is where a trip starts, not where it ends
values.subheadline: Registration tools get people signed up. UniteTrip also runs everything that comes after: rooms, itineraries, chat, budgets and the traveler app.

rows.title: What registration tools leave to you

values.text: Hotels, room types and a rooming list for every stay, with a room invoice for the hotel.
A day-by-day itinerary for each traveler, with flights, buses and events, and a printable badge.
A trip budget that weighs costs against what travelers pay, and an expense report for receipts and reimbursements.
A group chat for every trip, with photos, reactions and a daily digest email for the people who missed it.
Travelers carry their itinerary, chat and photos on their phone, with notifications when something changes.
One person registers, pays for and manages a whole household, and each member can still have a login of their own.

values.heading: Registration is built in too
values.body:
Travelers register on your own site with the admission options, age-based prices, deposits, discount codes and questions you set, and sign your trip documents online.

You approve each registration, see who has paid and check people in on the day.

values.heading: Payments go straight to you
values.body:
Connect your organization's own Stripe or PayPal account. Stripe takes cards, US bank accounts, Apple Pay and Google Pay, and every payment lands in a ledger for the trip and the traveler.

UniteTrip adds no fee of its own to any payment.

children.title: Do travelers have to install the app?

values.body: No. Everything works on your website in any browser. The app is there for travelers who want their trip on their phone.
Yes, one for all of their trips. They sign in with a password, a one-time email code or a passkey, and see every trip they are on in one place.
